reasons: Deposit TX-86933 failed. It must not be credited; provider reversals usually take 3–5 business days, not a guaranteed arrival date.
model_notes: Baseline accepted: deposit / P2 / Support. Customer writes in Vietnamese; reply must be in Vietnamese (language of the message, not of the country record). TX-86933 is a deposit of 500,000 VND via VietPay, created 2026-09-27T14:05Z, status failed (updated 14:06Z). Policy: a failed deposit is NEVER credited, so the balance correctly remains 0 — do not say it will be added, do not manually credit, and do not call it a system error to be fixed. The customer says the bank already debited them; per finance-month-end-sept.md#payment-providers, VietPay had 23 failed deposits on bank timeouts and all were auto-reversed by the provider, which is consistent with the statement that the provider reverses to source in usually 3-5 business days. Do not promise an exact date or claim the reversal has completed. Because 2026-09-27 was a Sunday, a 3-5 business day count from then is only just beginning; avoid any date arithmetic in the reply. No escalation: this is a documented case and the reversal is the provider's normal path. Sources: tickets.json#T-5107, transactions.csv#TX-86933, support-handbook-v2.md#deposits, finance-month-end-sept.md#payment-providers.
